subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which existing EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError fix path should own the remaining session-state, typing, and message-delivery behavior for this issue?
rationale: Current main includes a retained-lock release fix, but live related PRs propose broader and partly competing fixes for silent delivery loss, false takeover detection, and abort/fallback semantics.

options.title: Sequence Existing PRs
options.body: Pick one canonical PR or ordered set of existing PRs to cover silent delivery loss and false takeover handling before considering new repair work.

options.title: Split The Umbrella
options.body: Keep the lock-retention slice as fixed and move message delivery, typing, and fence false positives into narrower canonical issues or PRs.

options.title: Close Broader Recovery
options.body: Reject broader embedded takeover recovery work and document operational serialization or restart workarounds instead.

recommendation.title: Sequence Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Pick one canonical PR or ordered set of existing PRs to cover silent delivery loss and false takeover handling before considering new repair work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the partial retained-lock fix and is the clearest visible owner for deciding whether the remaining overlapping PRs should be sequenced, split, or rejected.
